DBS Tech China is seeking an exceptional full stack engineering team lead to join our Advisory technical team in Wealth Management Technology department. This pivotal role will contribute to drive the overarching engineering, architecture, and product strategy at a platform level, shaping the future of our digital, advisory, and discretionary investment journeys for millions of customers across retail, affluent, and private banking segments.

You will manage a significant engineering organization, foster innovation, and operate with a long-term strategic vision across digitally managed portfolios and professionally managed discretionary mandates.

Responsibilities

  • Design solutioning for enterprise-grade portfolio and wealth management platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future-proofing.
  • Engineering and build end-to-end portfolio solution, including:
    • Digital / low-touch investment portfolios
    • Advisory-guided portfolios
    • Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) mandates for HNW and UHNW
  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of complex full-stack solutions that underpin critical portfolio management journeys (portfolio modelling, portfolio constructions, automated/semi-automated rebalancing, mandate management etc) across a wide array of products (Bonds, Structured Products, Equities, etc.).
  • Oversee and manage up to 2 squads of highly skilled full-stack engineers, providing strategic direction, technical guidance, and fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.
  • Champion the adoption of cutting-edge technologies, distributed micro-frontend architectures, and advanced engineering practices to build world-class platforms.
  • Enforce best practices for CI/CD, DevOps, and deployment strategies utilizing platforms like OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), ensuring operational excellence and rapid delivery.
  • Nurturing and developing engineering talent, including setting performance expectations, providing mentorship, and promoting continuous learning.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI assistant coding tools and other emerging technologies into the development ecosystem to maximize efficiency and innovation.
Requirements

  • Experienced in building, and delivering large-scale, enterprise-grade full-stack platforms using Java, ReactJS, and Python.
  • Proven expertise in designing, implementing and operate mission-critical investment and portfolio managements system that serve millions of users, with a focus on high availability, low latency and strong operational resilience.
  • Deep architectural knowledge of distributed systems, micro-services, and advanced micro-frontend patterns.
  • Mastery of CI/CD methodologies, advanced DevOps practices, and significant experience with cloud-native deployment platforms such as OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) or similar.
  • Ability to lead and inspire multiple engineering squads and drive large-scale technical initiatives.
  • Strong strategic thinking and planning capabilities, with a proven ability to define and execute long-term technology roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience in leveraging and integrating AI assistant coding tools and other innovative technologies to enhance engineering productivity and capabilities.
  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an advanced degree is a plus.

Technical skills:

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/Typescript, including DOM manipulation and the JavaScript object model
  • Strong proficiency in CSS
  • Thorough understanding of React.js and its core principles
  • Experience on building complex React App
  • Experience with popular React.js workflows (such as Flux or Redux)
  • Experience with popular unit testing frameworks/libraries(such as Jest/Vite/React Testing Library/Enzyme)
  • Experience with Redux Saga/RTK/RTK Query
  • Familiarity with newer specifications of ES6
  • Knowledge of isomorphic React is a plus
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs
  • Knowledge of modern authorization mechanisms, such as JSON Web Token
  • Familiarity with modern front-end build pipelines and tools
  • Experience with common front-end development tools such as Rspack, Esbuild, Webpack, NPM, etc.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements
  • A knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Familiarity with code versioning tools such as Git.
  • Experience on using AI tool: Claude code/Codex/…
  • Have good knowledge on Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture.
  • Build micro-services using SpringBoot, single page application using React and others.
  • Implement core practice of Agile, leveraging cloud native architecture pattern using Test Driven Development (TDD), continuous integration/continuous delivery, in an on-premise or public-cloud environment, where everything is automated.

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4461087315.descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
  • Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
  • Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
  • Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
  • Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
  • Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
  • Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
  • Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
  • 15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
  • Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
  • Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
  • Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
  • Experience with high code and low code agent platform
  • Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
  • Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
  • Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
  • Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
  • Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

BBVA’s Corporate Lending Asia team is seeking a motivated corporate banking professional to support the origination, structuring, and execution of corporate loan transactions across the Asia-Pacific region. Based in Hong Kong or Shanghai, this role is embedded within the regional platform and plays an integral part in delivering live deals across the full transaction lifecycle.


Working closely with senior originators and key stakeholders, the successful candidate will cover syndicated loans,acquisition financings, sustainable finance, and bespoke credit solutions. Primary market coverage is China, with scope to expand regionally over time.


This position offers deep exposure to complex credit transactions and progressive career growth within a dynamic, expanding business.


Key Responsibilities:

▪ Support corporate lending transactions across all stages of the deal lifecycle, including credit analysis, pitch preparation, term sheet development, loan structuring, and documentation, contributing to high-quality deal delivery

▪ Conduct market, industry, and company research to generate insights that support credit, pricing, and structuring decisions

▪ Maintain and analyze precedent and comparable transaction data to support market intelligence, deal origination and strategic decisions

▪ Prepare and present proposals to business and credit committees for deal approvals

▪ Draft, review, and coordinate loan and syndication documentation, including term sheets, mandate letters, facility agreements, fee letters, and information memoranda

▪ Collaborate closely with internal teams – including Coverage, Risk, Loan Syndicate and Sales, Legal, Compliance, Tax, Sustainable Finance, Operations – as well as external stakeholders such as clients, partner banks and legal counsel to ensure smooth and timely transaction execution

▪ Manage transaction closings, including documentation execution, internal loan booking, and the

preparation of internal and external case studies and post-deal analyses

▪ Prepare management presentations and pipeline activity reports

▪ Ensure compliance with internal policies, audit standards, filing requirements, and documentation

procedures for all completed transactions

▪ Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline

▪ Minimum 2-4 years of relevant experience in corporate loan origination, debt structuring, or loan

syndication within corporate or investment banking.



Knowledge & Skills

▪ Demonstrated experience in corporate loan origination, debt structuring, and end-to-end deal

execution.

▪ Strong corporate credit analysis, financial modeling, debt capacity assessment, and risk management

capabilities.

▪ Excellent analytical, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with a strong client focus.

▪ Proficient in MS Office, Bloomberg, and Refinitiv (LoanConnector)


Language

▪ Fluent in spoken and written English and Mandarin

Job Summary

Support Brokerage business daily trading activities and perform daily trade settlement and clearing, cash & trade reconciliation.

Key Responsibilities

Business

  • Manage critical operational processes and controls and deliver a high-quality settlement and clearing service.
  • Support Brokerage business daily trading activities and perform daily trade settlement and clearing, cash & trade reconciliation.
  • Prepare daily, monthly and quarterly regulatory reports and other internal management reports.
  • Prepare daily client statements.
  • Execute trade settlement and clearing, cash & trade reconciliation, record filing and quality checking.
  • Maintain Exchange, inter-bank markets and Clearing house membership, settlement accounts and bank accounts.
  • Ensure processing of all transaction with accuracy and timely manner.
  • Resolve queries raised by clients and stakeholders and develop strong working relationship with them.
  • Ensure that operating instructions, checklists, SLA are kept up to date to ensure practicing of the same.
  • Identify and highlight the open risk areas in the process and highlight the same to management and work towards addressing the risk.
  • Support internal and external audit, Business Continuity Management, third party risk management, contract management, and other tasks and activities in COO area.
  • Review regularly and improve current BAU processes and Department Operating Instructions.
  • Communicate and discuss operational issues and activities with clients, business stakeholders, external parties, and other internal and external supporting functions.
  • Understand securities markets and securities products. Be familiar with related regulatory requirement.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Knowledge of PRC Securities Law
  • Understanding of the key features of relevant laws and regulations in China where relevant business is conducted
  • Experience in securities brokerage, securities dealing and trading, asset management, securities services and corporate finance
  • 6-8 years of working experience in operation support, settlement and clearing in China domestic market
  • Familiar with trade processing systems (such as Rootnet, xQuant) used in local China market
  • Oral and written English and Mandarin Chinese

Qualifications

  • Certifications: The successful candidate needs to hold China Securities Qualification Certificate.
  • Languages: Chinese & English

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Software Engineer.

Business: CTO Platforms

Principal Responsibilities

  • Backend development & delivery for RAG (incl. Graph RAG & agentic search): Contribute to building RAG backend capabilities, including retrieval, re-ranking, context construction, prompt orchestration, and response aggregation. Exposure to Graph RAG patterns (e.g., entity/relation extraction, basic graph traversal) and agentic search concepts (e.g., multi-step retrieval, tool/function calling) is a plus.
  • Build pipelines for multi-modal and multi-type data (documents, emails, wikis, images, tables, logs, structured sources), including extraction/OCR, chunking, enrichment, embedding, and incremental re-indexing with rollback.
  • Retrieval, ranking & graph reasoning optimisation: Implement hybrid retrieval (BM25/vector/structured filters), multi-stage recall, reranking (cross-encoder/LLM), deduplication/diversity controls, and graph-based retrieval strategies to improve relevance, explainability, and traceability.
  • Grounded, supported answer generation: Build generation workflows that produce grounded answers with explicit support (citations, quoted evidence snippets, and source metadata), including answer structuring, confidence/scoring signals, refusal/insufficient-evidence handling, and traceable “why this answer” outputs for auditability.
  • Security & compliance: Implement and maintain security controls such as access control (RBAC/ABAC), data classification/masking, audit logging, encryption, and secrets management. Strategy

  • Drive high standards of regulatory compliance and deliver key priorities and initiatives, aligned to WRB CFCR’s Priorities.

Business

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the business model and strategy in order to provide substantive oversight, support and challenge in order to enable appropriate and sustainable CFCR outcomes.

  • Work closely with the business and its operational teams to provide timely advice to ensure compliance with all relevant laws and regulations and support the transition to pro-active and pre-emptive CFCR risk mitigation.
  • Support the resolution of competing requirements between regulations specific to WRB businesses (for example, between AML regulations and data privacy/bank secrecy or information security regulations.)
  • Promoting the culture and practice of global standards to the business, while managing local requirements.

Processes

  • Act under delegation from the respective Risk Framework Owners for the Principal Risk Types of CFCR in discharging the responsibilities contained in ERMF to the extent that CFCR advisory is the second line risk framework owner.
  • The role holder is not responsible to ensure that WRB and CFCR process owners agree their respective handoffs, which ought to be documented in a service level agreement. However, consistent with the CFCR advisory second line responsibilities under ERMF, the role holder is responsible for ensuring that in the absence of an agreement or if responsibilities are poorly executed, the risks inherent in WRB are addressed in line with ERMF.
  • Develop / maintain effective CFCR policies/standards/processes/DOIs (including training, advice and support) to address CFCR risks across WRB, aligning with relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Provide governance and oversight over the implementation of CFCR related policies and standards relevant to WRB (to enable compliance with such policies and standards).
  • Provide support and challenge to WRB to ensure that they establish and monitor appropriate processes for compliance with CFCR policies and standards (including meeting regulatory obligations and maintaining high standards of conduct).
  • Establish and maintain effective processes (including training, advice and support) to ensure that policies, procedures and standards to address compliance risks are effectively implemented and adhered to.

  • Ensure proactive and timely identification, assessment, advice and dissemination of evolving regulatory changes/practices and associated risks, and proactive engagement in regulatory reform impacting WRB.

  • Maintain oversight of risk acceptance and/or mitigating action plans relating to WRB.
  • Understand relevant technical aspects of systems pertinent to WRB.
  • Ensure global / regional CFCR standards applicable to WRB are understood and implemented locally, with any identified exceptions, or need for more/less stringent standards, escalated to WRB CFCR Head as applicable.
  • In collaboration with the Country Compliance Assurance team ensure that local risks associated with the business in the Country are reflected in country risk assessments, with compliance reviews established where necessary and ensure Compliance involvement in the resolving and identified regulatory or compliance issues relevant to the businesses.
  • Ensure effective management of compliance matters, and in collaboration with the rest of the Compliance team, effectively manage regulatory issues that have a significant impact on the Bank.

Governance

  • Ensure swift remediation of regulatory breaches in WRB.
  • Ensure appropriate product governance measures are in place for WRB so that product approval documents reflect all relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Propose control effectiveness and efficiency improvements and simplifications to WRB where appropriate.
  • Ensure the end-to-end life cycle of audit, assurance and regulatory reviews in WRB is managed appropriately, including tracking, remediation and preparing lessons learned from such reviews.
  • Within the Group's Enterprise Risk Management Framework, support the WRB CFCR Head to establish and maintain appropriate risk based CFCR framework for identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, mitigating and reporting compliance (including regulatory and financial crime) risks in relation to WRB.

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
